restaurantName: Tiong Bahru Hainanese Boneless Chicken Rice
address: Tiong Bahru Market, #02-82, 30 Seng Poh Road, 168898, Singapore
bio: The rice that comes with the signature Hainanese boneless chicken imparts a mild turmeric aroma. Tender juicy meat, without too much fat under the bouncy, gelatinous skin. The roast chicken is also recommended....
